Dear Sir / Madam,  
 
In compliance with regulation 30 read with Schedule III to the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the audio recording of the conference 
call held today to discuss the financial results of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 is

https://bluejethealthcare.com/investor-presentation/ 
 
We request you to take the same on your record. 
 
Thanking you,  
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For Blue Jet Healthcare Limited
